name: zlib
version: 1.3.2
source: https://github.com/madler/zlib
tag: v1.3.2
artifact: https://zlib.net/zlib-1.3.2.tar.gz
license: zlib (see LICENSE)

The git snapshot gitignores /zconf.h because ./configure writes it. The
release tarball ships zconf.h as a byte-for-byte copy of zconf.h.in; zlib's
CMakeLists.txt file(READ)s that path at configure time. zui keeps the tarball
copy in-tree so add_subdirectory(third_party/zlib) works without running
./configure. Makefile from the tarball is still gitignored (Unix configure
output; CMake does not use it).
